title: Studio engine smoke test
purpose: Confirm the standalone localhost studio loads both native React engines without leaving the application or exposing target-game branding.

steps.title: Open the local studio
steps.expected: The VOXL Studio shell loads from localhost.

steps.title: Wait for the default skin editor
steps.expected: The lazy-loaded native skin editor is visible.

steps.title: Confirm product identity
steps.expected: The standalone product brand is visible.

steps.title: Confirm native editor status
steps.expected: The selected engine is represented by a native React editor.

steps.title: Confirm the 3D preview
steps.expected: The WebGL character preview is visible.

steps.title: Capture the skin engine
steps.expected: Full-page evidence shows the complete default editor at the active viewport.

steps.title: Switch to the motion engine
steps.expected: The engine switcher activates the transparent-character editor.

steps.title: Wait for the motion editor
steps.expected: The native motion editor is visible.

steps.title: Confirm motion paint tools
steps.expected: The motion editor exposes its native paint controls.

steps.title: Capture the motion engine
steps.expected: Full-page evidence shows the complete motion editor at the active viewport.
